panels.description: Daily COD reduction: primary = inlet → primary clarifier average, secondary = primary clarifier average → SBR average, overall = inlet → outlet.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '') AS loc, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 219 AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'COD' AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) GROUP BY 1, 2),
s AS (SELECT day, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc = 'CETP Inlet') AS i, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc IN ('Primary Clarifier 1','Primary Clarifier 2')) AS pc, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc ~ '^SBR [1-4]$') AS sbr, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc = 'CETP Outfall') AS o FROM d GROUP BY day)
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, 'Primary' AS metric, 100 * (i - pc) / NULLIF(i, 0) AS value FROM s WHERE i > 0 AND pc IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'), 'Secondary', 100 * (pc - sbr) / NULLIF(pc, 0) FROM s WHERE pc > 0 AND sbr IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'), 'Overall', 100 * (i - o) / NULLIF(i, 0) FROM s WHERE i > 0 AND o IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '') AS loc, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 219 AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'TSS' AND btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Decanter%' AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) GROUP BY 1, 2),
s AS (SELECT day, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc = 'Decanter 1 Inlet') AS feed, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc = 'Decanter 1 Centrate') AS c1, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc = 'Decanter 3 Centrate') AS c3 FROM d GROUP BY day)
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, 'Decanter 1' AS metric, 100 * (feed - c1) / NULLIF(feed, 0) AS value FROM s WHERE feed > 0 AND c1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'), 'Decanter 3', 100 * (feed - c3) / NULLIF(feed, 0) FROM s WHERE feed > 0 AND c3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
